items.title: ‘The Industry At Large Benefits From Independent Thought & Experimentation’ Says Co-Founder of Dance Festival Elements
items.summary: The independent fest is happening this weekend in Long Pond, PA. Co-founder Brett Herman talks about Elements' growth and "infinite plan of upgrades."
items.body: The 2026 edition of Elements festival is getting underway today (Aug. 7) at Pocono Raceway in Long Pond, Pennsylvania. Having started in 2013 as a one-day event in Brooklyn, Elements has over the years transformed into a sprawling three-day fest in the Pocono Mountains, with the event itself largely taking place in the woods behind the racetrack. While Elements is and always has been an independent festival, it’s got a lineup to compete with any major dance gathering. This year’s bill includes Charlotte de Witte, Chris Lake, Subtronics, Porter Robinson, Of the Trees, Above & Beyond, Cloonee, Excision and Azzeca, with organizers expecting a crowd of up to 40,000, up from the 33,000 hosted in 2025. The event is produced by its co-founders Brett Herman and Timothy Monkiewicz along with a core team of 20 and many more during the festival itself. With its whimsical vibes, Elements draws comparisons to other North American dance festivals Lightning in a Bottle, Electric Forest and Shambhala, and draws many of the same attendees as well. Tartikoff joins SiriusXM from Paramount Pictures, where she served as executive vp of global communications. items.body: نبأ سار افتتح الحارس البلجيكي تيبو كورتوا مرحلة جديدة من استعداداته مع ريال مدريد ، بعدما انضم إلى تدريبات الفريق عقب انتهاء مشاركته في كأس العالم وحصوله على الإجازة الصيفية، ليصبح أحدث العائدين إلى صفوف الفريق استعدادًا للموسم الجديد. ووفقا لصحيفة "ماركا" الإسبانية ، أصبح كورتوا تحت تصرف المدرب جوزيه مورينيو، بعدما أنهى مشاركته في كأس العالم الذي أقيم في الولايات المتحدة بتعرضه لانزعاج عضلي طفيف خلال مواجهة إسبانيا، قبل أن يصبح جاهزًا للعودة إلى العمل مع الفريق. ورغم سفر ريال مدريد إلى المجر لخوض مباراته الودية الثانية في فترة الإعداد للموسم الجديد، فإن كورتوا توجه إلى مدينة ريال مدريد الرياضية في فالديبيباس لمواصلة برنامجه التدريبي. وكما فعل ديوماندي في يومه الأول لاعبا في ريال مدريد، خاض الحارس البلجيكي تدريبات فردية تحت أشعة الشمس الحارقة في العاصمة الإسبانية، على أن ينتظر عودة الفريق لاستئناف العمل الجماعي استعدادًا للمباراة الودية المقبلة أمام ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا. وخلال الأسبوع المقبل، سيستعيد ريال مدريد المزيد من لاعبيه العائدين من كأس العالم، إذ ينتظر انضمام مارك كوكوريلا، وإبراهيما كوناتي، وأوريلين تشواميني، وكيليان مبابي، وهم آخر اللاعبين المنتظر عودتهم، ليكتمل قوام الفريق تحت قيادة مورينيو قبل انطلاق منافسات الدوري.

items.body: TL;DR Google’s been working on a new Gemini Feature called Proactive Assistance since at least earlier this year. Google’s Pixel 11 launch event will be upon us in just a few more days, and beyond the new hardware that’s set to debut, you can sure expect Google to be showing off its latest software developments. items.title: الجملة التي غيّرت مسار المفاوضات.. فينيسيوس يكشف وجهته الحقيقية
items.summary: ماذا قال؟
items.body: ماذا قال؟ حسم البرازيلي فينيسيوس جونيور، نجم ريال مدريد، موقفه من التجديد مع النادي الملكي، بعدما أكد لوكلائه تمسكه بالاستمرار داخل ملعب سانتياجو برنابيو، مشددًا على أن رحيله لن يكون مطروحًا إلا في حالة واحدة فقط، وهي شعوره بأن النادي لم يعد يرغب في استمراره. وقال فينيسيوس خلال المفاوضات، وفقًا لما نقلته صحيفة "جلوبو" البرازيلية، إن قراره واضح بشأن مستقبله مع ريال مدريد: "سأغادر ريال مدريد فقط إذا شعرت أنهم لا يريدونني. هذا هو ناديي"، في رسالة عكست ارتباط اللاعب بالفريق الذي شهد تألقه وتحوله إلى أحد أبرز نجوم كرة القدم العالمية. وجاء موقف المهاجم البرازيلي في وقت كانت فيه مفاوضات تجديد عقده قد شهدت حالة من التعقيد استمرت لأشهر؛ بسبب خلافات بين الطرفين حول التفاصيل المالية للاتفاق الجديد، وعلى رأسها قيمة مكافأة التوقيع وبعض البنود المرتبطة بالأداء، في ظل اقتراب نهاية عقده الحالي في يونيو 2027، وهو ما وضع إدارة النادي أمام ضرورة حسم الملف لتجنب فقدان أحد أهم عناصر الفريق دون مقابل بعد موسم واحد فقط. وأكدت التقارير أن فينيسيوس لم يضع أي شروط تتعلق بتغيير حقوق صورته، كما لم تكن مطالبه المالية هي العامل الأساسي في موقفه، إذ ركز اللاعب على رغبته في مواصلة مسيرته مع ريال مدريد، النادي الذي يعتبره بيته، وهو ما ساهم في تقريب وجهات النظر بين الطرفين والوصول إلى اتفاق نهائي.

items.title: Forget Recorder — Google’s working on a new AI-powered voice notes tool
items.summary: Conversation Capture is coming.
items.body: TL;DR Android Authority has reviewed strings related to a new Pixel feature called Conversation Capture. Conversation Capture will record and transcribe audio, and with optional Gemini integration. We expect this feature will debut on the Pixel 11 series. One of Google’s best machine-learning enabled products has long been its Pixel-exclusive Recorder app, which makes searchable transcriptions of your recordings. Now, Google is integrating that basic concept deeper into the Android experience with a feature called Conversation Capture. Poking around the latest version of the Android System Intelligence app , we’ve seen a whole bunch of strings about Conversation Capture. Internally codenamed Auris, the feature sounds very similar to Google’s existing Recorder app, but built more deeply integrated with both Android and Gemini.

items.title: Nest smart home devices are getting an upgrade that will make pairing easier
items.summary: Nest smart home devices are getting upgraded to Thread 1.4.
items.body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Google recently rolled out Thread 1.4 to the Google TV Streamer. Users are reporting that Thread 1.4 has now come to Nest devices. These devices include the Nest Hub, Nest Hub Gen 2, Nest Hub Max, and Nest WiFi Pro. In June, Google finally threw the Google TV Streamer a bone and gave the device its first major OTA update of 2026 . In addition to applying bug fixes and improvements, the update also brought support for Thread 1.4. Now that same support is starting to extend to the company’s smart displays and mesh system. It appears Google is rolling out Thread 1.4 to more devices. Users are reporting on Reddit that their Nest Hub devices have been upgraded to the latest version of the standard. The devices that have received the update, according to the post, include the Nest Hub, Nest Hub Gen 2, Nest Hub Max, and Nest WiFi Pro.

In doing so, they may have captured empty space behaving in a way physicists have predicted for 90 years , but never directly observed. Magnetars are a special class of neutron stars with ultra-strong magnetic fields, the strongest of any object in the observable universe, around a trillion times stronger than the strongest permanent magnets ever built on Earth. The latest Android Canary 2608 release comes with a redesigned icon for the Terminal app , giving the developer-focused tool a much more modern look. items.title: Google Messages makes one-handed use much easier with new rollout

items.body: Credit: Sanuj Bhatia / Android Authority TL;DR Google Messages is expanding its server-side rollout of the floating context menu and selective text copying to more beta users. The redesigned floating menu places actions like Reply, Copy, Edit, Star, and Delete in a clean vertical list right by the text bubble for easier one-handed use. Selective text copying introduces draggable handles, allowing users to highlight specific details without copying an entire message. Google Messages finally appears to be expanding a major usability refresh to more users, bringing its redesigned floating context menu and selective text copying to (slightly) wider availability. Reddit user seeareeff reports that they could finally see the new floating context menu when long-pressing a message bubble. Rather than dumping action icons into the top action bar (which forced awkward hand re-gripping on larger phones), the vertical floating menu appears right below/above the text. Essential actions like Reply, Copy, Edit, Star, and Delete are neatly grouped in a clean list format that makes one-handed interaction far less frustrating.

items.title: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is the wrong Samsung foldable to buy this year
items.summary: It's giving middle-child energy.
items.body: Samsung gave us two very different foldables this year: the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra . Both these foldables are aimed at completely different people. The Fold 8 introduces a new direction for Samsung with a wider display, a thinner chassis, and a much more compact feel in the hand. Meanwhile, the Fold 8 Ultra carries forward what the Galaxy Z Fold 7 started, refining that familiar formula. Here’s the thing, though: you’d expect two completely different form factors to come with equally different feature sets. Instead, they’re remarkably similar, and the Fold 8 Ultra is priced just $200 more than the Fold 8. That’s exactly what got me thinking. For such a relatively small price increase, the Ultra offers enough extra value that it almost feels like Samsung is nudging buyers in that direction.

items.body: TL;DR OnePlus has opened the first global ColorOS closed beta for the OnePlus 15 and 15R. The testing program is currently limited to Indian variants and excludes US, EU, and global models. OnePlus hasn’t confirmed the wider rollout yet. OnePlus has officially begun its transition from OxygenOS to ColorOS , opening the first global Closed Beta Testing (CBT) program for the OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 15R. If you’ve been wondering when the software migration announced alongside the company’s withdrawal from the US and European smartphone markets would actually begin, this is the clearest sign yet that it’s now underway. items.title: Google reveals how much free space Chrome wants to install local AI models
items.summary: It's kind of a lot.
items.body: TL;DR Google has updated its support documentation to show that downloading the models that power Chrome’s on-device AI features requires approximately 20 gigabytes of available storage space. The install size of the models is still approximately 4 GB, Google has confirmed. You can disable Chrome’s on-device AI features in the browser’s settings. Google’s been working for a while to integrate Gemini more deeply into Chrome for some time now. Some users were confused and annoyed this spring when Chrome started automatically downloading a multi-gigabyte file called weights.bin that enables Gemini Nano features to run locally. Now, Google’s updated its documentation to reflect that you’ll actually need quite a bit more free space to actually download the files required for local AI features. As spotted by Windows Report (via PiunikaWeb ), the Google Chrome Help Center entry about the browser’s on-device generative AI models has been updated to reflect that you’ll need approximately 20 gigs of free disk space to install the models that power local AI features. You’ll also need an unmetered data connection, plus “ Sufficient device performance.”

items.title: Google Wallet now lets kids tap to pay without giving up parental control
items.summary: Your child gets tap to pay, but not a free pass to overspend.
items.body: TL;DR Google Wallet now supports supervised balances for kids and teens under 18 in the US, giving them a way to make digital payments with parental oversight. Parents can set daily spending limits, view transaction history, receive Family Link purchase alerts, and remotely lock the Wallet if a device is lost. Kids can tap to pay using their Android phone or Wear OS smartwatch anywhere Google Pay is accepted. Giving kids money has always involved a bit of trust. Maybe it’s cash for a weekend outing, a card for an emergency, or money to grab something while they’re out with friends. The problem is that cash is easy to lose, cards can go missing, and it’s not always obvious where the money ended up. That’s exactly the problem Google Wallet is now trying to solve. The company is rolling out supervised Google Wallet balances for children and teenagers under 18 in the US. Instead of handing your child a debit card and simply hoping they spend responsibly, you’ll be able to decide how much money they have access to while still keeping an eye on where it’s going. It’s a much more practical way to let kids start managing their own money without throwing them in at the deep end.

items.title: Signal finally makes using multiple Android devices much easier
items.summary: You no longer have to choose which phone gets to keep your Signal chats.
items.body: TL;DR Signal now lets you link another Android phone or tablet to your existing account. You can optionally transfer your message history and the last 45 days of media. The update also redesigns Android tablet and foldable layout, ditching legacy single-screen navigation. For years, one of Signal’s biggest pain points when compared to other messaging apps wasn’t encryption, voice calls, or missing features. It was the awkward experience of moving between devices. If you wanted to use a second Android phone or tablet, you were largely out of luck. That finally changes with the latest update. Signal has announced a major expansion of its linked devices feature, allowing users to connect another Android phone or Android tablet to their existing account. The feature arrives in Signal Android v8.20, while Signal iOS v8.22 similarly lets iPhone users link another iPhone alongside existing iPad support.

items.title: Reddit is letting AI decide when your post breaks the rules
items.summary: The machines are moving into the mod queue, and they can be given the power to delete your posts.
items.body: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR Reddit’s new Rules Hub uses AI to judge whether posts and comments violate the “intent” of subreddit rules. Moderators decide whether suspected violations are flagged for review or removed automatically. The optional tool is rolling out more widely later in 2026, following testing in over 700 communities. Reddit moderation has never exactly been a polished operation. It runs on volunteer moderators, user reports, and Automod rules that may have been written years ago by someone who has since vanished from the subreddit. Perhaps inevitably, AI is now also being invited behind the scenes at Reddit, with a new system that can decide whether posts and comments should be reported or removed. As The Verge reports, Reddit’s new Rules Hub uses large language models to judge whether content matches the “intent” of a subreddit rule. Automod usually looks for specific words, phrases, or patterns, while the new system is meant to understand context and handle messier cases that don’t fit neatly into a keyword filter.
